main:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Reads n, fills an n by n matrix with consecutive integers, processes n*n input positions by zeroing each position and accumulating the minimum remaining non-zero count in the four cardinal directions for interior positions, then prints the accumulated total." main]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read an integer from standard input and store it in n. RESULT n]
            [COMMAND Declare a 501 by 501 integer array a, and long variables p, k, and cnt. Initialize k to 1 and cnt to 0; p is declared but uninitialized. RESULT state]
            [COMMAND Fill the n by n prefix of array a in row-major order: for i from 0 to n-1 and for j from 0 to n-1, set a[i][j] to the current value of k, then increment k. This assigns consecutive integers 1 through n*n to the filled cells. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND For ii from 0 to n*n-1, read a long integer p from standard input and process p according to the following position rules. RESULT p]
            [COMMAND In loop iteration ii, if 1 <= p and n >= p, then p is in the first row: set a[0][p-1] to 0 and skip the remaining else-if branches for this iteration. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND In loop iteration ii, otherwise if n*n >= p and n*n - n + 1 <= p, then p is in the last row: set a[n-1][n - n*n + p - 1] to 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND In loop iteration ii, otherwise if p % n == 0, then p is in the rightmost column: set a[(p/n) - 1][n-1] to 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND In loop iteration ii, otherwise if p % n == 1, then p is in the leftmost column: set a[p/n][0] to 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND In loop iteration ii, otherwise p is an interior cell: set a[p/n][(p % n) - 1] to 0. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND In the interior path of loop iteration ii, compute zero-based row i = p / n and zero-based column j = (p % n) - 1. RESULT i_and_j]
            [COMMAND In the interior path of loop iteration ii, initialize the array m with five long elements using m[0] = i, m[1] = n-1-i, m[2] = j, m[3] = n-1-j, and m[4] = 0; only the first four elements are used. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND In the interior path of loop iteration ii, for jj from 0 to i-1, if a[jj][j] equals 0, decrement m[0]. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND In the interior path of loop iteration ii, for jj from n-1 down to i+1, if a[jj][j] equals 0, decrement m[1]. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND In the interior path of loop iteration ii, for jj from 0 to j-1, if a[i][jj] equals 0, decrement m[2]. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND In the interior path of loop iteration ii, for jj from n-1 down to j+1, if a[i][jj] equals 0, decrement m[3]. RESULT m]
            [COMMAND In the interior path of loop iteration ii, sort the first four elements of m with qsort using compare_int so that m[0] becomes the smallest of the four direction counts. RESULT m_sorted]
            [COMMAND In the interior path of loop iteration ii, set mm to m[0] and add mm to cnt. RESULT cnt]
            [COMMAND After completing all n*n iterations, print cnt as a long integer followed by a newline and return 0. RESULT output]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
